crossRefs.note: Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened or…
The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”
His watchmen are blind. They are all without knowledge. They are all mute dogs. They can’t bark— dreaming, lying down…
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
“Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and tell them, ‘When I bring the sword on a land, and the people of…
I will stand at my watch, and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I…
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they…
“Cry aloud! Don’t spare! Lift up your voice like a trumpet! Declare to my people their disobedience, and to the house…
“Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over Yahweh’s house, because they have broken my covenant…
Does the trumpet alarm sound in a city, without the people being afraid? Does evil happen to a city, and Yahweh hasn’t…
But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

translations.web: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’
translations.bsb: I appointed watchmen over you and said, ‘Listen for the sound of the ram’s horn.’ But they answered, ‘We will not listen!’
translations.kjv: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
translations.asv: And I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet; but they said, We will not hearken.
